finding.packet_premise: docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_ANIMATION.md proposed the five addresses as the GUI widget parent chain, 'the scale pair at +18h/+1Ch' and the vtable slots +4Ch and +58h the scroll block drives.
finding.actual: The five are the transform of the GUI widget base class built by 00AA9390. The pair at +18h/+1Ch is the Pivot, a fraction of the widget's own size; Scale is a separate pair at +28h/+2Ch that the parent chain never touches. The widget publishes into a scene node at +4Ch rather than drawing itself.

correction.claim_corrected: docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_ANIMATION.md line 247: 'apply the parent's scale pair at +18h/+1Ch times its size pair at +20h/+24h'
evidence: Descriptor table 00AAAED0 binds widget+18h to the literal Pivot at 00d5c228 (record 00AAAFAD, string push 00AAAFF3), widget+20h to Size at 00cff278 (00AAAF54 / 00AAAF9F) and widget+28h to Scale at 00ce60ac (00AAB006 / 00AAB034).
Base constructor 00AA9390 leaves +18h/+1Ch at zero (00AA93A6) and sets +28h/+2Ch to 1.0 from 00d7a24c (00AA93B4).
00AA7220 makes a translation matrix out of +18h/+1Ch times +20h/+24h and a diagonal scale matrix out of +28h/+2Ch.

finding.vtable_confirmed: Base vtable 00d5bbf8 holds 00AA7970 at +58h and 00AA6980 at +4Ch, confirming the size setter and alpha setter that docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_ANIMATION.md named from use. 00d5bed0 is a sibling table with the same two slots.

matrix_multiply_chain.helper: 00413920 BSP_Matrix_Multiply4x4, __thiscall(left, destination, right), RET 8, EAX = destination, row-major left*right
matrix_multiply_chain.why_the_order_is_certain: 00b64780 ends in a bare RET and cleans nothing, so its two pushed arguments at 00AA740F and 00AA7417 survive and are reused as the third multiply's arguments. Seven pushes total 1Ch bytes and must be undone before POP EDI at 00AA745E; three multiplies cleaning 8 each plus a __thiscall virtual cleaning 4 is exactly 1Ch, and no other split of RET sizes closes the frame.
matrix_multiply_chain.effective_order_on_row_vectors: pivot, then scale, then rotate, then translate

uncertainties: Which WideScreenAlign literal, Left or Right, is 1 and which is 2. The descriptor record at 00AAB27D emits both names and the pairing was not read.
Where the Visible flag is stored. Virtual +5Ch returns the type tag, so the gate at 00AAB2E9 is a type test rather than a visibility read.
What the constant at 00d5c118 is a fraction of, and whether the 0.75 at 00e12fc4 is genuinely the 4:3 aspect ratio.
The class name; neither vtable has an MSVC complete-object locator.
The byte at +0Dh of 0109cf04 is read as 'wide screen is on' from this one use.
00AAB4C0, the remaining caller of both publishes, was read only to its first twenty instructions.
00AA7970 (vtable +58h) recomposes the transform but never refreshes the bounding volume, so a resize can leave the node's bounds stale. Whether that is a defect in hit testing was not tested.
